touring-caravan:v1.observation: Canonical and native candidate were inspected in the preceding uninterrupted review: complete vertical chamfered closed shell, upward hitch, four wheels at two widely separated longitudinal stations, two closed roof panels and central frame with two longitudinal highlights.
